ko.executive_summary: Nvidia expands R&D footprint with Shanghai center, while SK Hynix removes credential barriers in new hiring to strengthen talent acquisition amid competitive pressures.
key_facts: Nvidia establishes R&D center in Shanghai
SK Hynix implements open recruitment for new graduates, prioritizing growth potential over educational credentials

implications.text: Nvidia's Shanghai R&D presence signals commitment to local innovation capabilities despite geopolitical constraints.
SK Hynix relaxing credential requirements reflects intensified competition for semiconductor engineering talent in Asia.

ko.counterpoint: Nvidia's R&D expansion scope and investment level remain undisclosed.
